fomod.Name: OStim Together
fomod.Author: OStim Together project
fomod.Description: Synchronizes OStim Standalone scenes through Skyrim Together Reborn. Uses one unified remote scene-anchor pipeline for physical furniture, free-standing and wall scenes, with synchronized participant alignment, scene controls and NPC undressing. v0.35.3 is a safety hotfix: it disables the experimental live CumOverlays NiSkinInstance deep-clone repair introduced in v0.35.2 after CrashLogger confirmed an access violation in Skyrim's DeepCopyStream during climax on Body [OvlN]. The established non-destructive RaceMenu/SKEE overlay synchronization, PPA integration, scene anchors and OCum equip meshes remain unchanged while the overlay relink strategy is reworked without live skin cloning.
